dhcp.title: DHCP Setup
dhcp.server_ip_desc: IP address of this device on the network
dhcp.allow_only: Assign addresses only to allowed computers
dhcp.allow_only_hint: The list itself is managed on the Allowed computers page (DHCP menu).
dhcp.name: Name
dhcp.saved_ip_hint: The device will use this address after a reboot.
dhcp.dns_auto_hint: Auto: uses the built-in DNS server if it is enabled, otherwise the router.

dhcp_allowed.title: Allowed Computers
dhcp_allowed.desc: If "Assign addresses only to allowed computers" is switched on in DHCP → General, only the computers in this list receive an address.
dhcp_allowed.info_static: A computer with a Static Binding whose Enable checkbox is on is always allowed — listing it here is optional.
dhcp_allowed.state_on: The list is active: addresses go only to allowed computers and to enabled static bindings.
dhcp_allowed.state_off: The list is inactive: "Assign addresses only to allowed computers" in DHCP → General is switched off.
dhcp_allowed.state_empty: The list is empty while the switch is on — no computer will get an address.
dhcp_allowed.unavailable: The PSRAM MAC table is unavailable — the list is not applied and every computer is served.
dhcp_allowed.lookup_name: Detect the computer name by MAC
dhcp_allowed.lookup_err: Could not look the name up
dhcp_allowed.lookup_replace_hint: The field already holds a different name.
dhcp_allowed.note_none_no_ip: The name is unknown: the computer has no address from this device, so there is nobody to ask.
dhcp_allowed.note_none: The name is unknown: the computer did not report one, reverse DNS returned no name for its address and NetBIOS did not answer.
dhcp_allowed.save_needs_mac: A row has a name but no MAC address — fill the address in or remove the row.
dhcp_allowed.note_cleared: The name field is cleared · press Save

dns.title: DNS Setup
dns.local_hosts_desc: Custom domain → IP mappings resolved by this DNS server.

time.title: Time Server
time.manual_below_min: Date/time is earlier than the minimum:

dns_internal.title: Internal Cache
dns_internal.reset_hint: Every entry of the internal cache is dropped from PSRAM. The file on the card is left alone Ч the next save overwrites it.
dns_internal.file_hint: The cache is written to /fat/cache.dat and restored automatically on boot.
dns_internal.psram_note: Internal cache is unavailable — no PSRAM detected on this device.
dns_internal.md5_mismatch: The cache file differs from the one this device saved (checksum mismatch).
dns_internal.md5_unknown: This device has no saved checksum for the cache file (fresh firmware, factory reset, or the file was put there another way).
dns_internal.md5_unreadable: The cache file could not be read.
dns_internal.md5_cancelled: Load cancelled: the checksum does not match.

settings_export.title: Export Settings
settings_export.desc: Download a full backup of the device settings as a JSON file. Passwords are not included.
settings_export.empty: Nothing to export, or settings could not be loaded.

settings_import.title: Import Settings
settings_import.desc: Choose a settings backup file (*.conf, JSON) exported earlier and apply it. Only parameters supported by this firmware version are imported.
settings_import.file_newer: The file is from a newer firmware — unknown parameters will be skipped.
settings_import.reboot_required: Network parameters changed — reboot the device to apply the static IP.

files.title: Files
files.empty: The folder is empty. Upload a file or create a folder.
files.overwrite_note: "Overwrite" answers for this file, "Overwrite all" stops asking
files.delete_recursive_confirm: The folder is not empty. Delete it with all its contents?
files.delete_selected_hint: Folders are deleted with all their contents. This cannot be undone.
files.picker_no_dirs: No folders inside — confirm right here and the files go into this folder.
files.picker_source_hint: This is the source folder — pick another folder or the other volume.
files.check_truncated: stopped at the limit — not everything was read
files.repair_hint: The unreadable entries are deleted, folders with all their contents. This cannot be undone.
files.format_confirm1: Formatting the microSD erases ALL data on the card. Continue?
files.format_confirm2: Final confirmation: the data will be lost for good. Format?
files.conflict_hint: Overwrite replaces files and merges directories; skip leaves the destination and the source as they are.

settings_device.title: Device Management
settings_device.reboot_desc: Reboot the device without changing any settings. The web interface is unavailable for a few seconds while it restarts.
settings_device.reset_desc: Erase ALL settings and restore factory defaults: network, DHCP, DNS, static bindings, local hosts, DNS cache and the web login (admin/admin). The device reboots to apply the reset.
settings_device.confirm_reset: All settings will be reset to factory defaults (including the admin/admin login) and the device will reboot. Continue?
settings_device.ok_reset: Settings reset to factory defaults. The device is rebooting... Redirecting to login.

webupdate.title: Web Interface Update
webupdate.note: Existing files are overwritten. New pages are only reachable after a firmware update that registers a route for them.

jobs.title: Task Scheduler
jobs.desc: Long-running operations of every subsystem in one list: volume checks, file uploads, DNS cache writes, formatting, connection tests.
jobs.one_off: A one-off operation leaves the list as soon as it ends; a scheduled one stays together with its interval. A paused upload stays until it is continued or discarded.
jobs.unreachable: The list of operations is unavailable: the device did not answer.

restart.stats_failed: The statistics could not be saved.
restart.stats_failed_hint: Restarting now loses the counters collected so far: the file on the card stays as it was, and the device will only try to write it again during the restart.
restart.stats_failed_hint_update: The update will go ahead without the statistics being saved: the file on the card stays as it was, and the device will try to write it during the update.
restart.stats_not_saved: The statistics are not saved before this reboot: the “save statistics before reboot” switch is off.
restart.stats_no_verdict: The device did not report whether the statistics were saved — it will try again during the restart.
restart.stats_stalled: The statistics save has stopped: no answer for more than 10 seconds.
restart.cache_empty: The cache holds no live entry yet — nothing to save.
restart.cache_not_saved: The cache is not saved before this reboot: the “save the cache before a reboot” switch is off, or the internal cache itself is disabled.
restart.cache_failed: The cache could not be saved.
restart.cache_failed_hint: Restarting now loses the cache: the file on the card stays as it was, and the device will only try to write it again during the restart.
restart.cache_failed_hint_update: The update will go ahead without the cache being saved: the file on the card stays as it was, and the device will try to write it during the update.
restart.cache_stalled: The cache save has stopped: no progress for more than 10 seconds.
restart.cache_no_verdict: The device did not report whether the cache was written — it will try again during the restart.
restart.prep_unavailable: The device did not answer the preparation — it will save the files itself (its firmware may be older than this page).
restart.cancelled: Cancelled: the cache is not saved.
restart.cancelled_stats: Cancelled: the statistics are not saved.
restart.cancelled_update: Cancelled: the cache is not saved, the update was not performed.
restart.cancelled_stats_update: Cancelled: the statistics are not saved, the update was not performed.
